title: Checkpoint harness dispatch configuration
description: The run configuration sections an agent dispatch needs (Task 3 research log §§4, 10 and §12 T3-C; T3.5 H2 adds each role's effort; T3.6 L2 the optional learning limits). Planning accepts any object here; dispatch refuses until these sections are complete. Other sections are validated by run-config.schema.json.

kind.description: How the credential authenticates: a Console API key (default) or a Claude subscription OAuth token from `claude setup-token`.

provider.description: Reference to the environment variable holding the credential; never the credential itself.

retries.description: Protocol retries per step (T3-E): repeated production, admission, verification or review after a malformed result, a temporary fault or an interruption. The runner requires it; the adapter does not read it.

run_spend_usd.description: Optional spend limit of the whole run (T3.5 H3): an agent session starts only while reported costs, sessions of unknown cost and unresolved invocation allowances leave room for one more provider_spend_limit.usd.

provider_spend_limit.description: Hard spend limit per invocation. The provider checks its estimate only after each turn, so turn_reservation_usd is held back for the turn that crosses the limit.

learning.description: Evidence-backed learning (T3.6 L2, evidence-backed learning log §§2.2 and 2.5). Absent: no knowledge or guidance is selected and every packet and evaluation is as before. Present: each production attempt freezes a bounded selection of the step's current knowledge and guidance before dispatch. The limits bound what the producer sees and can read of it; omissions stay in the frozen manifest, and requirements, criteria, targets and findings are never cut.

reminder_chars.description: The most characters one guidance reminder may have; admission rejects a longer one.

entries.description: Most knowledge entries one attempt consumes.

guidance.description: Most guidance reminders one attempt consumes.

bytes.description: Most bytes of the consumed items and the record references they make readable, serialised. Omitted candidates reach the producer only as a count per reason.

phases.description: The runner's learning phases (T3.6 L3, evidence-backed learning log §§2.3, 2.4 and 2.6). Absent: the runner schedules none, as under L2, and the run cannot satisfy T3.6 feature proof. Present: after an attempt is decided `correct`, a proposal session and an independent review of each proposal; before the next attempt, at most one exploration round when a reviewed choice or a reviewed failure repeated across two correction attempts calls for one; and, after an explored attempt's independent review, the cross-attempt challenge its acceptance then needs. Every session reserves its allowance under the existing budgets. Whether learning and its phases are configured is fixed for the run.

exploration_rounds.description: Most exploration rounds the whole run may hold. A trigger once they are used pauses the run as exhausted; it is never skipped.

check_timeout_seconds.description: Longest time one diagnostic check may run, within run_command's limit.

model.description: A pinned Claude API model ID this adapter supports: the current lineup of https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview. Aliases such as claude-haiku-4-5 or claude-sonnet-4-5 resolve to the latest dated snapshot and are refused; adding an ID, with its EFFORT_LEVELS entry, is a reviewed change.

effort.description: The role's reasoning effort (T3.5 H2), sent with every request of its sessions. Dispatch also refuses a level the model does not accept (EFFORT_LEVELS in claude.ts); Claude Haiku 4.5 accepts none.

skill_digests.description: Expected SHA-256 of each selected skill's SKILL.md; a mismatch refuses dispatch.
